question: Which black-garmented trident-bearing power is worshipped as Ketu in the mind-lotus?
premises: Ketu holds power and trident in hand
The speaker worships Ketu in the mind-lotus
inference: The verse identifies Ketu as the worshipped black-garmented power.
uncertainties: śakti and triśūla relation is compressed
